newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return fall in auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return fall in auction.

text.p: Mexico's 1,092 day UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 98.56431 UDIs and a real return of 7.03 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the 1,065 day UDI bonds had a real return of 7.15 percent.
Demand this week was 141.81 million UDIs compared to 250 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico.
The 1,820-day UDIs were assigned at a price of 97.96959 UDIs and a real return of 6.98 percent.
Two weeks ago the 1,751-day UDI bonds had a real return of 7.11 percent.
Demand this week was 159.77 million UDIs compared to the 250 million UDIs on offer.
